command_visibility.stock_frontend_limit: codex-cli 0.155.0 has no remote slash-command allowlist; fixed unsupported commands remain client-visible and are rejected without execution
command_visibility.permission_meaning: Wire compatibility only. Registry grants, owner policy and runtime isolation remain authoritative.

agent_projection.independent_agent_task: separate Registry and PetriNet; never a subagent thread
agent_projection.subagent_thread_spawn: not advertised until a truthful parent-owned delegation bridge exists

verification.policy: Validation results belong to fixed commits and CI artifacts, not static status claims.

unsupported_methods.thread/attachment/*: No Registry-backed delivery exists. Requests fail explicitly; historical UI metadata is preserved but not advertised or executed.
unsupported_methods.skills/config/write: Native RPNH plugins are not Codex backend skills.
unsupported_methods.mcpServer/*: No frontend-owned MCP execution or authentication.
unsupported_methods.process/*: No execution outside the RPNH Registry/Petri gateway.

method_classes.meaning: Empty discovery is a compatibility response, not an installed capability.
